post.description:
Accept a PDF, Word (.docx) or plain-text CV, extract skills against the taxonomy.

Safety rules:
  - Content type must be application/pdf or text/plain (4xx otherwise).
  - File must be under MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (413 if exceeded).
  - Extracted text is capped at 200,000 characters (truncated=True in response).
  - The file is processed in memory and never stored (AGENTS.md §3).
  - CPU-bound parsing runs in a thread via asyncio.to_thread to avoid
    blocking the event loop.

SyncReport.description: Result of refreshing reference data from its live source.

hours_share.title: Hours Share
hours_share.description: Share of planned learning hours linked to this target; not measured SDG impact. Targets may overlap.

observed_from.title: Observed From
observed_from.description: Start of the period the source data measures; may predate snapshot_date.

observed_to.title: Observed To
observed_to.description: End of the period the source data measures.

TrendRecommendationMeta.title: TrendRecommendationMeta
TrendRecommendationMeta.description: Legacy trend endpoints retain the same explicit origin as snapshot/freshness.

conclusion.title: Conclusion
conclusion.description: GitHub run conclusion once completed, e.g. success, failure.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: None until GitHub lists the new run.

dispatched.title: Dispatched
dispatched.description: True when this request started the run.

already_running.title: Already Running
already_running.description: True when an earlier run was still queued or in progress.

snapshot_date.title: Snapshot Date
snapshot_date.description: Latest snapshot the app serves after a completed run.

TrendRefreshStatus.title: TrendRefreshStatus
TrendRefreshStatus.description: State of the GitHub Actions trend refresh run (the workflow publishes the snapshot).

snapshot_date.title: Snapshot Date
snapshot_date.description: New snapshot date (published) or the one still live.

TrendRescoreResult.title: TrendRescoreResult
TrendRescoreResult.description: Outcome of re-scoring the latest stored signals (no ingest, no model call).

trend_coverage.title: Trend Coverage
trend_coverage.description: Roles only: share of the role's skill importance that has trend data.

insufficient_evidence.title: Insufficient Evidence
insufficient_evidence.description: Roles only: trend_coverage is below 0.5, so the direction is not reliable.

snapshot_date.title: Snapshot Date
snapshot_date.description: Snapshot version/slot label, not its observation or retrieval date.

labor_decay_is_static.title: Labor Decay Is Static
labor_decay_is_static.description: If true, labor_decay does not change between snapshots unless manually refreshed; diffing logic should only compare velocity_moderate/velocity_fast between snapshots.

data_provenance_note.title: Data Provenance Note
data_provenance_note.description: Optional explanation of data provenance, e.g. for historical arXiv date-window pulls or demo calibration.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Completions not yet confirmed or rejected.

id.title: Id
id.description: 'personal' or an organisation id (sent as X-Workspace).

name.title: Name
name.description: Organisation name; empty for the personal workspace.

Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: A workspace the signed-in person can switch to.
